blocks: The people of the State of California do enact as follows:

It is the intent of the Legislature to enact subsequent legislation that ensures broader and more equitable access to election materials for limited English proficient voters in order to reduce barriers to voting for underserved language communities in California elections.
digest: Existing state and federal law, including the federal Voting Rights Act of 1965, require the Secretary of State and county elections officials to provide language assistance to voters in order to access voting information, register to vote, and cast their votes at the polling place.

This bill would state the intent of the Legislature to enact subsequent legislation that ensures broader and more equitable access to election materials for limited English proficient voters in order to reduce barriers to voting for underserved language communities in California elections.
label: Introduced
subject: Election materials: language assistance.
title: An act relating to elections.
